E1216

A `targets:` block has an unknown field

What

A `targets:` block has an unknown field

Why

A `targets:` block has a fixed set of fields, and this name isn't one of them

Fix

Remove the unknown `targets:` field or replace it with a supported field.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1216: tests/ui/manifest_bad_target_field/stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownTargetsField]: `package.jet` has an invalid target field
 Why: Package `web`: unknown target field `api` (allowed: `entry`, `name`)
 Fix: A target block accepts `entry: "…"` and `name: "…"`
